title: American Bronze v. Streamway Products
summary: A longstanding order-and-production practice gave significance to the supplier’s response to new orders.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The parties had used telephone orders followed by purchase orders for roughly twenty years. The appellate court reversed and remanded the denial of the buyer’s claim, invoking § 2-204 and the regular practice. The relevant inference comes from the course of dealings, not from the buyer’s unilateral declaration that silence means acceptance.
